notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar. Blasting Station and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers. Resolve both triggers from this step and step 3, untapping it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat
